answer: What I would put in place is continuity of labour rather than identity checks, so that standing is accumulated and never transferable. Anyone can verify the fold without permission, so mass copying collapses to the cost of redoing all prior work for each copy — a price no lantern of fake identities can pay. Growth therefore stays slow, like a ripple laying down new wood, and a swarm of imitation dune ripens long after its funding runs out.
